points.quote: Create the identifier with `createDecorator<IFooService>('fooService')` ... The same name is used for the `const` and the type
A consumer declares the dependency as a constructor parameter decorator: `constructor(@IFooService private readonly fooService: IFooService) {}`
`InstantiationService` (`instantiationService.ts:28`) does the resolving. `createInstance(Ctor, ...staticArgs)` looks up the class's dependencies and fetches each one
Registration happens as a side effect of importing the module, for example from `workbench.common.main.ts` and the other `*.main.ts` files.
